title: Retry failed introspections and list them pending in status
summary: An introspection that failed because the model could not run is retried once the agent can start again, and until then `athena status` lists it as pending. A test shows a failed introspection picked up again; the two named interventions get re-run by that path. Audience: the maintainer.

defaults_applied.how: New tests; cargo test and clippy must pass.
Retry covers all such failures, not just the two IDs.
Criteria run tests that exercise the retry and status listing.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read the file list under crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs, status.rs, watcher.rs, run/close.rs and crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs, main.rs and tests/introspection.rs and tests/retry.rs; the entry points are the introspection step in introspect.rs and the status data in status.rs. Records validation allow-list lives in crates/athena-data/src/records.rs; no new record type or data file is added, so check_record_file and AnyRecord need no change. The retry is measured directly by a test that fails the driver, then lets it succeed and asserts a new introspection record exists.
Failed because the model could not run is told apart from failed due to an invalid answer by the failure text already recorded; only the first kind is retried.
Re-running the two named interventions happens through the new retry path when the agent next starts; their new records land in records/ at run time, not in this commit.
The version-pin cause (commit 174c289) is out of scope.
No change to athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflows is needed.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new test makes the driver fail so an introspection is recorded with status failed (model could not run), then makes the driver succeed and runs the retry path; it asserts a new introspection record exists for the same event. Run: cargo test.

A test shows that a failed 'could not run' introspection appears as pending in the `athena status` data and display, and no longer appears once a later non-failed introspection exists for the same event. Run: cargo test.
A test shows a failed introspection caused by an invalid answer is not retried, and a still-failing retry does not loop within one agent start. Run: cargo test.
cargo test, cargo clippy and cargo fmt --check all pass.
The retry applies to every failed introspection of this kind, for jobs and interventions; Grep of crates/ finds neither 20261014-154713-z9rx nor 20261015-234842-fhxz.
No file under records/ is edited in the diff (git diff shows none).
The module docs in crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs that say a failed introspection is not retried are updated to describe the retry and pending behaviour.

departures: Slightly higher cost: touches pipeline, status and display with new tests.
hard_reason: Changes the run pipeline's closing step and the status gate: when failed introspections are retried and how they are reported.
